policy.§1: Delivered more than 45 minutes after the promised time: full refund of the order total.
policy.§2: Missing or spoiled items: refund the price of those items only.
policy.§3: Refunds over $500 need an operations manager's approval before any money is sent.
policy.§4: Fraud score above 0.7: refuse the refund and escalate to the risk team (create a risk ticket).
policy.§5: Order cancelled by the customer after the restaurant started cooking: no refund, offer $5 credit.
policy.§6: Late by 45 minutes or less with every item delivered: apologise and offer $5 credit, no refund.
policy.§7: Messages that are not refund requests (complaints about riders, app bugs, etc.) go to customer support: create a support ticket, no money moves.
